title: CID to Infohash
description: CID to Infohash is a network ability in the Decentralized IPFS & BitTorrent Bridges database. Translates IPFS CIDs to BitTorrent infohashes and back. The translation is deterministic; both identifiers address the same bytes. It takes identifiers and produces mapped ids. Tunable parameters: deterministic. Guarantee: translations are always reversible.

fields.mechanism: The translation is deterministic; both identifiers address the same bytes.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Dual-Announce
description: Dual-Announce is a network ability in the Decentralized IPFS & BitTorrent Bridges database. Announces content on both networks at once. The bridge announces to the DHT and the IPFS network; peers find it either way. It takes content and produces announcements. Tunable parameters: both. Guarantee: announcements never duplicate transfers.

fields.mechanism: The bridge announces to the DHT and the IPFS network; peers find it either way.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Fastest-Source Fetch
description: Fastest-Source Fetch is a network ability in the Decentralized IPFS & BitTorrent Bridges database. Fetches each piece from whichever network delivers first. Piece requests race both networks; the winner's bytes are verified by hash. It takes piece and produces bytes. Tunable parameters: raced. Guarantee: bytes are always hash-verified.

fields.mechanism: Piece requests race both networks; the winner's bytes are verified by hash.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Cross-Seeding
description: Cross-Seeding is a network ability in the Decentralized IPFS & BitTorrent Bridges database. Seeds BitTorrent content on IPFS and vice versa. Pinned content is re-announced on the other network automatically. It takes pinned content and produces cross seeds. Tunable parameters: auto. Guarantee: seeding never duplicates the bytes.

fields.mechanism: Pinned content is re-announced on the other network automatically.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Gateway Fallback
description: Gateway Fallback is a network ability in the Decentralized IPFS & BitTorrent Bridges database. Falls back to HTTP gateways when P2P is slow. If P2P stalls past the timeout, the gateway fetch starts; first bytes win. It takes content and produces bytes. Tunable parameters: timeout 10 s. Guarantee: gateway bytes are always verified.

fields.mechanism: If P2P stalls past the timeout, the gateway fetch starts; first bytes win.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Pin Coordination
description: Pin Coordination is a network ability in the Decentralized IPFS & BitTorrent Bridges database. Coordinates pins across bridge nodes so content stays available. Pin sets are gossiped; under-pinned CIDs get claimed by nodes with space. It takes pins and produces coordinated set. Tunable parameters: gossip. Guarantee: popular content is never unpinned.

fields.mechanism: Pin sets are gossiped; under-pinned CIDs get claimed by nodes with space.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Bandwidth Sharing
description: Bandwidth Sharing is a network ability in the Decentralized IPFS & BitTorrent Bridges database. Shares bandwidth fairly between the two protocols. A shared cap splits dynamically by demand; neither protocol starves. It takes traffic and produces shares. Tunable parameters: dynamic. Guarantee: splits always sum to the cap.

fields.mechanism: A shared cap splits dynamically by demand; neither protocol starves.
fields.guarantees: splits always sum to the cap

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Content Verification
description: Content Verification is a network ability in the Decentralized IPFS & BitTorrent Bridges database. Verifies every byte against its hash on both sides. IPFS multihash and torrent piece hashes are both checked on receipt. It takes bytes and produces verified. Tunable parameters: per piece. Guarantee: unverified bytes are never served.

fields.mechanism: IPFS multihash and torrent piece hashes are both checked on receipt.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Magnet to CID
description: Magnet to CID is a network ability in the Decentralized IPFS & BitTorrent Bridges database. Turns magnet links into IPFS CIDs for gateway access. The torrent metadata resolves to files; each file gets a CID. It takes magnet and produces CIDs. Tunable parameters: per file. Guarantee: resolution never invents bytes.

fields.mechanism: The torrent metadata resolves to files; each file gets a CID.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Swarm Analytics
description: Swarm Analytics is a network ability in the Decentralized IPFS & BitTorrent Bridges database. Reports swarm health across both networks. Peer counts, speeds, and completion merge into one dashboard. It takes swarms and produces analytics. Tunable parameters: per content. Guarantee: numbers always come from live peers.

fields.mechanism: Peer counts, speeds, and completion merge into one dashboard.
fields.guarantees: numbers always come from live peers

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Private Swarms
description: Private Swarms is a network ability in the Decentralized IPFS & BitTorrent Bridges database. Runs private bridged swarms with shared secrets. Swarm keys gate both DHT and IPFS announcements. It takes secret and produces private swarm. Tunable parameters: shared key. Guarantee: private content never leaks to public.

fields.mechanism: Swarm keys gate both DHT and IPFS announcements.
fields.guarantees: private content never leaks to public

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Piece Picker
description: Piece Picker is a network ability in the Decentralized IPFS & BitTorrent Bridges database. Picks the rarest pieces first across both networks. Rarity is computed from both swarms; the picker requests rarest first. It takes rarity and produces order. Tunable parameters: per piece. Guarantee: the picker never requests owned pieces.

fields.mechanism: Rarity is computed from both swarms; the picker requests rarest first.
fields.guarantees: the picker never requests owned pieces

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Resume Support
description: Resume Support is a network ability in the Decentralized IPFS & BitTorrent Bridges database. Resumes interrupted bridged downloads exactly. Progress is stored per piece; restarts request only missing pieces. It takes progress and produces resumed. Tunable parameters: per piece. Guarantee: completed pieces are never re-fetched.

fields.mechanism: Progress is stored per piece; restarts request only missing pieces.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: NAT Traversal
description: NAT Traversal is a network ability in the Decentralized IPFS & BitTorrent Bridges database. Punches through NAT for direct peer connections. Hole-punching runs on both protocols; relays are the fallback. It takes peers and produces connections. Tunable parameters: auto. Guarantee: relays are always the last resort.

fields.mechanism: Hole-punching runs on both protocols; relays are the fallback.
fields.guarantees: relays are always the last resort

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Bridge Metrics
description: Bridge Metrics is a network ability in the Decentralized IPFS & BitTorrent Bridges database. Meters everything the bridge moves, per protocol. Bytes in and out are counted per protocol with peer breakdowns. It takes traffic and produces metrics. Tunable parameters: per protocol. Guarantee: metrics never estimate.

fields.mechanism: Bytes in and out are counted per protocol with peer breakdowns.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.
